title: Newborn and Baby Photography Sessions in the RGV area
content:
<!-- wp:html -->
<div id="adrisabel-photography-page">
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500&family=Great+Vibes&family=DM+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400&display=swap');

    #adrisabel-photography-page,
    #adrisabel-photography-page * ,
    #adrisabel-photography-page *::before,
    #adrisabel-photography-page *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page {
      --pink-100: #FFF0F5;
      --pink-200: #FFE4E1;
      --pink-300: #FFB6C1;
      --pink-400: #F4A0B0;
      --pink-500: #E8899A;
      --rose-gold: #B76E79;
      --rose-gold-light: #D4A0A8;
      --gold: #C9A96E;
      --gold-light: #E8D5A8;
      --cream: #FFFAF7;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --text-dark: #4A3540;
      --text-medium: #7A6570;
      --text-light: #A8929C;
      --font-display: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      --font-script: 'Great Vibes', cursive;
      --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;

      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      background: var(--cream);
      color: var(--text-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page a,
    #adrisabel-photography-page button,
    #adrisabel-photography-page input,
    #adrisabel-photography-page textarea,
    #adrisabel-photography-page select {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
      height: auto;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .ap-page {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: var(--cream);
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* URGENCY STRIP */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .urgency-strip {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF3D7F 0%, #FF1F6D 50%, #E8006B 100%);
      color: white;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 102;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(232, 0, 107, 0.25);
      animation: apPulseGlow 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .urgency-strip strong { font-weight: 800; }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .urgency-strip .urgency-flash {
      display: inline-block;
      animation: apFlashIcon 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
      margin-right: 0.25rem;
    }

    @keyframes apPulseGlow {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(232, 0, 107, 0.25); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(232, 0, 107, 0.55); }
    }

    @keyframes apFlashIcon {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.75; transform: scale(1.15); }
    }

    /* NAVBAR */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .navbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255, 250, 247, 0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.2);
      padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .navbar.scrolled {
      box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.08);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-logo-icon {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-logo-text {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-logo-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-dark);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-logo-sub {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 0.5rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.3em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
      margin-top: 0.22rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-phone {
      display: none;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      text-decoration: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-phone:hover { color: var(--rose-gold); }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-cta {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rose-gold), var(--pink-400));
      color: white;
      border: none;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem;
      border-radius: 50px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.3);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .nav-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.4);
    }

    /* HERO */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: calc(100vh - 80px);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--pink-100) 0%, var(--cream) 100%);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      left: -50%;
      width: 200%;
      height: 200%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 80%, rgba(232, 213, 168, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
      animation: apHeroGlow 15s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @keyframes apHeroGlow {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
      100% { transform: translate(-5%, 3%) scale(1.05); }
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-sparkle {
      position: absolute;
      width: 4px;
      height: 4px;
      background: var(--gold-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: apSparkle 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-sparkle:nth-child(1) { top: 15%; left: 20%; animation-delay: 0s; }
    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-sparkle:nth-child(2) { top: 25%; right: 15%; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-sparkle:nth-child(3) { top: 60%; left: 10%; animation-delay: 1.5s; }
    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-sparkle:nth-child(4) { top: 70%; right: 20%; animation-delay: 2.2s; }
    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-sparkle:nth-child(5) { top: 40%; left: 85%; animation-delay: 0.4s; }

    @keyframes apSparkle {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0); }
      50% { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(1); }
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-badge {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.3);
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      max-width: 92%;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-badge strong {
      color: var(--text-dark);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-title {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 400;
      font-size: 2rem;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-top: 0.6rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      max-width: 420px;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-title em,
    #adrisabel-photography-page .section-title em,
    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-name em,
    #adrisabel-photography-page .cta-banner h2 em,
    #adrisabel-photography-page .story-content h3 em,
    #adrisabel-photography-page .final-cta h2 em {
      font-family: var(--font-script);
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
      font-size: 1.1em;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-subtitle {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 300;
      color: var(--text-medium);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
      max-width: 360px;
    }

    /* HERO MARQUEE */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-marquee {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: calc(100% + 3rem);
      margin: 0 -1.5rem 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #000 8%, #000 92%, transparent 100%);
      mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #000 8%, #000 92%, transparent 100%);
      padding: 0;
      line-height: 0;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-marquee-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      width: max-content;
      animation: apHeroScroll 45s linear infinite;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-marquee:hover .hero-marquee-track {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-marquee-item {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 165px;
      height: 215px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow:
        0 10px 28px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.18),
        0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85),
        0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.2);
      position: relative;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-marquee-item img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: brightness(1.02) contrast(0.98) saturate(0.92);
    }

    @keyframes apHeroScroll {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-cta-group {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      align-items: center;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 320px;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .btn-primary {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rose-gold) 0%, var(--pink-400) 100%);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      padding: 1rem 2rem;
      border-radius: 50px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.25);
      width: 100%;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.35);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .btn-secondary {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--rose-gold-light);
      padding: 0.9rem 1.8rem;
      border-radius: 50px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      width: 100%;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--pink-100);
      border-color: var(--rose-gold);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-trust {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 0.85rem;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: var(--text-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .hero-trust-stars {
      color: var(--gold);
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    }

    /* STATS */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .stats-ribbon {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rose-gold) 0%, var(--pink-500) 50%, var(--rose-gold) 100%);
      padding: 1.25rem 1rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      align-items: center;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .stats-ribbon::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cpath d='M30 10 Q35 0 40 10 Q50 25 30 40 Q10 25 20 10 Q25 0 30 10Z' fill='rgba(255,255,255,0.03)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E") repeat;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .stat-item { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .stat-number {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .stat-number.stat-stars {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      padding-top: 0.25rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .stat-label {
      font-size: 0.58rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      margin-top: 0.3rem;
    }

    /* COMMON */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .section {
      padding: 4rem 1.5rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .section-label {
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.25em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 300;
      color: var(--text-medium);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 420px;
      margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
    }

    /* TRUST BADGES */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .trust-badges {
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.15);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .trust-badges-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .trust-badge {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.75rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .trust-badge-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--pink-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .trust-badge-text {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    /* DETAILS */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .details {
      background: var(--cream);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .detail-cards {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .detail-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.2);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.05);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .detail-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.12);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .detail-icon {
      width: 60px;
      height: 60px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink-300), var(--pink-400));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 1rem;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.3);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .detail-card h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .detail-card p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-medium);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* GALLERY STRIP */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .gallery-strip {
      padding: 3rem 0;
      background: var(--white);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .gallery-scroll {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      animation: apScrollGallery 40s linear infinite;
      width: max-content;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .gallery-scroll img {
      width: 240px;
      height: 300px;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.12);
    }

    @keyframes apScrollGallery {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* SERVICES */
    #adrisabel-photography-page .services {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--pink-100) 0%, var(--cream) 100%);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.15);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(183, 110, 121, 0.15);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-card.featured {
      border: 2px solid var(--rose-gold-light);
      position: relative;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-featured-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 1rem;
      right: 1rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light));
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.55rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem;
      border-radius: 50px;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-image {
      width: 100%;
      height: 240px;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-body {
      padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-number {
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--rose-gold);
      margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-medium);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-features {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-features li {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-medium);
      padding: 0.45rem 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.1);
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-features li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-features li::before {
      content: '♥';
      color: var(--pink-300);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    #adrisabel-photography-page .service-btn {
      width: 100%;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rose-gold), var(--pink-400));
      color: white;
      border: none;
      padding: 1rem;
      border-radius: 50px;

        geoEl.dataset.loaded = 'true';
        try {
          var controller = new AbortController();
          var timeout = setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, 5000);

          fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', { signal: controller.signal })
            .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(); })
            .then(function (data) {
              clearTimeout(timeout);
              var city = data && data.city ? String(data.city).trim() : '';
              var region = data && data.region_code ? String(data.region_code).trim() : '';

        if (stickyCta) stickyCta.classList.toggle('visible', y > 600);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
      onScroll();

      var reveals = root.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          entries.forEach(function (entry) {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              entry.target.classList.add('visible');
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

        reveals.forEach(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      } else {
        reveals.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('visible'); });
      }

      root.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var item = btn.parentElement;
          var wasOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
          root.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(function (i) {
            i.classList.remove('open');
          });
          if (!wasOpen) item.classList.add('open');
        });
      });
    })();

Your baby's first birthday only happens once — and a cake smash session is the most joyful, unforgettable way to celebrate it. We set up a custom-designed scene with a beautiful cake, themed decorations, and your baby at the center of it all.

The result? Pure, unscripted joy. Messy fingers, frosting-covered smiles, and expressions you'll laugh about for years. These sessions are playful, colorful, and completely led by your baby's curiosity.

We handle everything — the setup, the decorations, and the cleanup. You just bring your baby and your camera-ready smile.

How Does a Cake Smash Session Work?

Every cake smash session starts with a planning consultation where we choose a theme, colors, and style that fits your family. Popular themes include floral, rustic, boho, classic, and character-inspired setups — but we can create almost anything.

On session day, we start with clean "before" portraits of your baby in their birthday outfit. Then the cake comes out, and the fun begins. We capture every messy, wonderful moment as your baby discovers the cake.

Sessions are typically booked for babies turning one, but we welcome any first birthday celebration. Book 4 to 6 weeks in advance so we have time to plan and coordinate the perfect setup.

Do I need to bring the cake?

How far in advance should I book?

Totally normal! Some babies dive right in, others take their time. We give baby plenty of space to explore at their own pace. I have tricks to encourage curiosity, and even the hesitant moments make for adorable photos.

Absolutely! Popular themes include floral, boho, rustic, woodland, safari, and classic pastel. But if you have something unique in mind, let's make it happen. Custom themes are one of my favorite parts of cake smash sessions.

Yes! Many families add a bubble bath or splash session after the smash for adorable cleanup photos. It's a great way to end the session on a sweet, playful note.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before booking your session.

When should I book my newborn photography session?

The best time to book is during your second or third trimester. Newborn sessions are ideally done within the first 5 to 14 days after birth, when babies are sleepiest and most comfortable in those soft, curled poses. Booking early guarantees your spot on the calendar.

What areas do you serve near McAllen?

Our studio is conveniently located in the heart of the Rio Grande Valley. We serve families from McAllen, Edinburg, Mission, Pharr, San Juan, Weslaco, Harlingen, Brownsville, Mercedes, Donna, Alamo, and surrounding communities within a 50-mile radius.

How long does a newborn session take?

Newborn sessions typically last 2 to 3 hours. We never rush — your baby sets the pace. We allow time for feeding, soothing, and diaper changes so the experience is calm and comfortable for everyone.

Is newborn photography safe?

Absolutely. Safety is our number one priority. Adrisabel has over 15 years of experience handling newborns and is trained in safe posing techniques. The studio is kept warm, clean, and stocked with everything your baby might need. Your baby's comfort and safety always come first.

How much does a photography session cost?

Session pricing depends on the type of session and your selected package. Visit our pricing page for current rates, or contact us to discuss a custom session tailored to your family's needs.
